verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity, fraud and compliance SaaS platform, so natural-language operation is a fair question for it. The evidence describes APIs, webhooks, workflows and 'agentic automation' for KYC/AML checks. Nothing shows users operating the product through natural-language commands; the agentic-automation claim describes automated compliance checks, not a natural-language command interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
